business_problem: TAL needed high-performance AI infrastructure and safe large-model tooling so it could train, iterate, and deploy its self-developed MathGPT model into education products fast enough to meet real classroom and device needs.
solution_summary: TAL Education Group worked with Baidu AI Cloud to support its Jiuzhang large model, MathGPT, using the BaiGe AI heterogeneous-compute platform and Qianfan large-model tooling. BaiGe provides the professional AI infrastructure required for large-model training and inference, including scalable compute, storage, networking, scheduling, fault tolerance, and operations support so TAL can start projects quickly, validate base models, and keep iteration moving. On top of that infrastructure, TAL uses Qianfan's full-stack workflow, SFT fine-tuning, plugin flexibility, and security controls to adapt the model with business data and education feedback. The resulting model is integrated into learning hardware such as the Xpad and powers capabilities such as instant math Q&A, AI video explanations, fingertip translation, encyclopedia Q&A, oral arithmetic practice, and dialog-based guided tutoring.

solution_components.role: Provides TAL with end-to-end large-model development, fine-tuning, plugin, and security capabilities.

solution_components.name: Qianfan AppBuilder

data_flow: Education data and business feedback are used to fine-tune MathGPT on Baidu's compute and model platform, then the resulting capabilities are pushed into smart-learning devices and tutoring workflows such as instant Q&A, AI explanations, and dialog-based study guidance.
business_outcome: TAL accelerated large-model iteration, brought MathGPT into production learning hardware, and improved student support with richer AI tutoring and answer-generation capabilities.
metrics: MathGPT can answer more than 80% of math questions instantly.
Effective training time on BaiGe can exceed 98%.
Unanswered questions can receive a human-explainer video in as little as 1 hour.
